Motion Studio · playtest issue 4 · 2026-11-11

See the move.
Feel the control.

Mirrored image thirds, comfortable standing head controls, and a live shared-stream learning preview. The runner world stays rendered.

Issue #64 · Runner pull request · Tracking dependency #61

What changed and why

Previous controls measured lane displacement relative to body size and demanded both shoulders, hips, knees and ankles. Projected knee angles and a mandatory six-action checklist could block otherwise usable camera input, while participants could not see which action was recognized. The new controls map the mirrored torso to absolute image thirds, use an explicitly captured comfortable standing height, and show the current lane, head thresholds, recognition and freshness beside the original 3D world.

AreaResult and tradeoff
Lane selectionOne mirror: display x = 1 − camera x. Left/center/right image thirds have ±0.018 width hysteresis. Current hip pair, then shoulder pair, supplies center. If both pairs are occluded, scoring pauses; a single rotating hip cannot choose a lane.
Jump / rollHead rise ≥0.075 body heights with shoulder and hip rise ≥0.035 for 45 source ms jumps once. Head drop ≥0.16 with torso drop ≥0.08 holds roll; release below 0.09. Available calibrated face joints fall back explicitly to shoulder height. Cropped legs are supported; no projected knee-angle gate.
Rearm100 source ms at standing: head ±0.065, torso ±0.025, available feet ±0.06 body heights. The torso standing band cannot overlap jump support. No face-loss jump rearm, held airborne retrigger or crouch-rise jump.
Learning / startRaw mirrored picture, thirds, head marker, numeric thresholds, lane/action and age/occlusion cues. Practice marks are optional. Camera acquisition, standing reference and Start remain explicit. No hazards or scoring advance during learning.
Ownership / recoveryUses tracking's opt-in 450 ms same-track recovery. Missing/tentative frames reach session ingestion; no old input scores. Only the same confident track may return before the fixed deadline, followed by fresh standing and countdown. Ambiguous/duplicate IDs or expiry require New run. Frame-loop expiry also covers silent streams.
Resource / camera lifecycleExisting JPEG packets only; no second capture, new model, weights or recording. At most one optional preview decode; no queue. Late images close after hide/stop/reset/disposal. Pending camera starts block replacements until their late acknowledgement is released; failed scoped release retains Retry.

All installs, focused tests, full checks, builds and browser runs use the campaign Windows-mutex serialization wrapper. Repository-local environments and existing cached dependencies are used. Local checks used Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and Python 3.12.16; hosted CI uses the repository-pinned Node 24.21.0. No GPU/inference benchmark or training was run.

Dependency and remaining limits

This focused PR is stacked on tracking PR #66 (codex/playtest-tracking), initially core f2f95d7e38c3559d5fae2f7a9a91fca8e9aa1766. Shared session/vision files belong to that dependency and are excluded from this runner diff. Other games, global navigation, and maze/calibration are outside scope.

Physical performance remains unmeasured. Standing calibration trusts the participant's explicit comfortable reference. Shoulder fallback and cropped-leg scale (2.6× torso height) are proposed image-space proxies, not verified takeoff, depth or room geometry. Supervised trials must measure false/missed actions, varied body sizes/movement ranges, turns/occlusion, framing, safe clearance and externally observed action-to-display latency. No exposure-time, model-accuracy or production-readiness claim follows from these synthetic checks.

Self-contained English HTML: embedded CSS and synthetic screenshots; no external rendering assets, credentials, participant footage or private participant data. Reproduce browser evidence with node scripts/verify-runner-controls.mjs and report layout with --report-only, through the campaign wrapper. Build packaging remains source-only runner plus its existing Vite consumer.
